motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial needle sweeps in crisp arcs. Speed lines flare and fade. Cel highlights flicker across the cabinet. Slow dramatic push-in.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial whip-pans across frequencies. Speed lines burst outward. Cel glow ignites from cold to blazing. Dynamic dolly push forward.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles. Cel glow cools from white to deep amber. Ink shadows lengthen. Slow dolly pull back.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. Equalizer bars bounce in flat color. Speed lines pulse with the bass. Slow orbit around the speaker.
